stored_text.note: The TSE compiled-legislation page holds the full Portuguese text of the resolution (ementa, arts. 9-B to 9-E, 27-A, 33-B and the new definitions). Text extracted by stripping HTML tags.

english_version.note: No English text in the stored file. One web search found only academic papers with English abstracts, no translation by the TSE or another public body.

title.source_quote:
RESOLUÇÃO Nº 23.732, DE 27 DE FEVEREIRO DE 2024
Altera a Res.-TSE nº 23.610, de 18 de dezembro de 2019, dispondo sobre a propaganda eleitoral.
title.why: The number and date in original_title match the source apart from capitalisation, but the parenthetical '(altera a Res.-TSE nº 23.610/2019)' condenses the ementa and is not verbatim; the source's ementa is 'Altera a Res.-TSE nº 23.610, de 18 de dezembro de 2019, dispondo sobre a propaganda eleitoral.' The English title renders number, date and amended act correctly; the closing words 'AI and synthetic content rules' are a descriptive gloss that is not in the original title.

summary_claims.claim: bans deepfakes of real, deceased or fictitious persons used to harm or favour candidates (even with consent)
summary_claims.original_quote: § 1º É proibido o uso, para prejudicar ou para favorecer candidatura, de conteúdo sintético em formato de áudio, vídeo ou combinação de ambos, que tenha sido gerado ou manipulado digitalmente, ainda que mediante autorização, [...] imagem ou voz de pessoa viva, falecida ou fictícia (deep fake).
summary_claims.literal_translation: § 1. The use, to harm or to favour a candidacy, of synthetic content in audio, video or combined format that has been digitally generated or manipulated, even with authorisation, to create, replace or alter the image or voice of a living, deceased or fictitious person (deep fake) is prohibited.

summary_claims.claim: bars chatbots or avatars that simulate conversation with candidates
summary_claims.original_quote: § 3º O uso de chatbots, avatares e conteúdos sintéticos como artifício para intermediar a comunicação de campanha com pessoas naturais submete-se ao disposto no caput deste artigo, vedada qualquer simulação de interlocução com a pessoa candidata ou outra pessoa real.
summary_claims.literal_translation: § 3. The use of chatbots, avatars and synthetic content as a device to mediate campaign communication with natural persons is subject to the caput of this article [the disclosure duty], any simulation of dialogue with the candidate or another real person being prohibited.

summary_claims.claim: makes platforms jointly liable if they fail to remove non-compliant AI content
summary_claims.locator: Art. 1 (new Art. 9º-E, caput and item V)
summary_claims.original_quote: Art. 9º-E. Os provedores de aplicação serão solidariamente responsáveis, civil e administrativamente, quando não promoverem a indisponibilização imediata de conteúdos e contas, durante o período eleitoral, nos seguintes casos de risco:
summary_claims.literal_translation: Art. 9-E. Application providers shall be jointly and severally liable, civilly and administratively, when they do not immediately make contents and accounts unavailable, during the electoral period, in the following risk cases: [item V: content fabricated or manipulated by digital technologies, including AI, contrary to the labelling rules of this Resolution]

key_terms.note: Defined in the new art. 37, XXXV as image, video, audio, text or virtual object generated or significantly modified by digital technology, including AI.
The usual legal rendering is 'jointly and severally liable'; the register's wording keeps the meaning but drops the 'civilly and administratively' and 'during the electoral period' limits.
Both renderings are defensible; the record uses two different ones.

issues: original_title is not verbatim: its parenthetical condenses the ementa 'Altera a Res.-TSE nº 23.610, de 18 de dezembro de 2019, dispondo sobre a propaganda eleitoral.'
Summary says chatbots may not simulate conversation 'with candidates'; the text bars simulating dialogue with the candidate 'or another real person'.
'real, deceased or fictitious persons' renders 'pessoa viva, falecida ou fictícia'; 'living' is the literal word.
'jointly liable' renders 'solidariamente responsáveis' (jointly and severally), and the liability applies only during the electoral period.
note: Loss of registration or mandate (cassação do registro ou do mandato) in the summary is tied in art. 9-C § 2 to the deceptive-content and deepfake bans, not to all violations; the summary's wording is broad but not wrong.
